A scheduling app can be a game-changer for language tutors, allowing you to manage your bookings, schedule lessons, and communicate with students all in one place. With a scheduling app, you can:

  • Reduce no-shows and last-minute cancellations
  • Increase student engagement and satisfaction

Features to Include in Your Scheduling App

When building your scheduling app, there are several features you'll want to include to make it effective and user-friendly. Some of these features include:

Calendar Integration

Integrate your calendar with your scheduling app to ensure that all bookings and schedule changes are synced in real-time. This will help you avoid double bookings and ensure that you're always on top of your schedule.

Payment Processing

Include a payment processing feature to allow students to pay for lessons directly through the app. This will make it easy for students to book and pay for lessons, and will also help you keep track of payments and revenue.

Notification System

Set up a notification system to remind students of upcoming lessons and schedule changes. This will help reduce no-shows and ensure that students are always aware of their schedule.
